FILE_NOT_JSON.title: File is not JSON
FILE_NOT_JSON.summary: The file text could not be parsed as JSON.
FILE_NOT_JSON.message: This file is not valid JSON.
FILE_NOT_JSON.fix: Choose a file exported from AI Enabler, or repair the JSON syntax.

FILE_NOT_A_PROJECT.title: File is not a project
FILE_NOT_A_PROJECT.summary: The file is JSON but has no project envelope with a schema version.
FILE_NOT_A_PROJECT.message: This is not a project file. Choose a file exported from AI Enabler.
FILE_NOT_A_PROJECT.fix: Export a project from AI Enabler and import that file.

FILE_NEWER_SCHEMA.title: File uses a newer schema
FILE_NEWER_SCHEMA.summary: The file schema version is newer than the version this app supports.
FILE_NEWER_SCHEMA.message: This file uses schema {version}; this app supports up to {current}.
FILE_NEWER_SCHEMA.fix: Update the app or re-export the file from an older version.

FILE_UNRELEASED_SCHEMA.title: File uses an unreleased schema
FILE_UNRELEASED_SCHEMA.summary: The file schema version was never released.
FILE_UNRELEASED_SCHEMA.message: This file uses schema {version}, which was never released; this app supports up to {current}.
FILE_UNRELEASED_SCHEMA.fix: Re-export the file from a released version of the app.

FILE_NO_UPGRADE_PATH.title: No upgrade path for the file
FILE_NO_UPGRADE_PATH.summary: No chain of upgrades leads from the file schema to the current schema.
FILE_NO_UPGRADE_PATH.message: This file uses schema {version} and cannot be upgraded to {current}.
FILE_NO_UPGRADE_PATH.fix: Re-export the file from a released version of the app.

FILE_UPGRADE_FAILED.title: Upgrade failed
FILE_UPGRADE_FAILED.summary: An upgrade step threw while converting the file to the current schema.
FILE_UPGRADE_FAILED.message: Upgrading this file from schema {from} to {to} failed.
FILE_UPGRADE_FAILED.fix: Re-export the file from the app that created it.

FILE_UNREADABLE.title: File could not be read
FILE_UNREADABLE.summary: The browser could not read the chosen file, or its contents could not be checked.
FILE_UNREADABLE.message: This file could not be read or checked.
FILE_UNREADABLE.fix: Choose the file again, or check that it is not locked or moved.

FILE_PROJECT_NAME_EMPTY.title: Project name is empty
FILE_PROJECT_NAME_EMPTY.summary: The project name is missing, not text, or blank.
FILE_PROJECT_NAME_EMPTY.fix: Set project.name to a non-blank string.

FILE_PROJECT_ID_MISSING.title: Project id is missing
FILE_PROJECT_ID_MISSING.summary: The project id is missing or not a non-empty string.
FILE_PROJECT_ID_MISSING.fix: Set project.id to a non-empty string.

STEP_ID_MISSING.title: Step id is missing
STEP_ID_MISSING.summary: A step has no id, or its id is not a string.
STEP_ID_MISSING.fix: Give the step a unique string id.

STEP_ID_DUPLICATE.title: Step id is used twice
STEP_ID_DUPLICATE.summary: Two steps share the same id.
STEP_ID_DUPLICATE.message: {step} shares its id (id) "{id}" with an earlier step.
STEP_ID_DUPLICATE.fix: Give every step a different id.

STEP_POSITION_MISSING.title: Step position is missing
STEP_POSITION_MISSING.summary: A step has no numeric position x and y.
STEP_POSITION_MISSING.message: {step} is missing a position (position.x and position.y).
STEP_POSITION_MISSING.fix: Give the step a position with numeric x and y.

STEP_LABEL_MISSING.title: Step label is missing
STEP_LABEL_MISSING.summary: A step has no label, or its label is not a string.

STEP_TYPE_UNKNOWN.title: Step type is unknown
STEP_TYPE_UNKNOWN.summary: A step has a type other than the one supported step type.
STEP_TYPE_UNKNOWN.fix: Remove type, or set it to the supported step type.

STEP_COUNT_INVALID.title: Step count is invalid
STEP_COUNT_INVALID.summary: A step count field (pt, lt, queue or batch) is not a whole number of 0 or more.
STEP_COUNT_INVALID.message: {step}: {fieldLabel} ({field}) must be a whole number, 0 or more.
STEP_COUNT_INVALID.fix: Set the field to a whole number of 0 or more, or remove it.

STEP_PERCENT_INVALID.title: Step percentage is invalid
STEP_PERCENT_INVALID.summary: The %C&A field (ca) is not a number from 0 to 100.
STEP_PERCENT_INVALID.message: {step}: {fieldLabel} ({field}) must be a number from 0 to 100.
STEP_PERCENT_INVALID.fix: Set the field to a number from 0 to 100, or remove it.

CONN_ID_MISSING.title: Connection id is missing
CONN_ID_MISSING.summary: A connection has no id, or its id is not a non-empty string.
CONN_ID_MISSING.fix: Give the connection a unique, non-empty string id.

CONN_ID_DUPLICATE.title: Connection id is used twice
CONN_ID_DUPLICATE.summary: Two connections share the same id.
CONN_ID_DUPLICATE.message: {connection} shares its id (id) "{id}" with an earlier connection.
CONN_ID_DUPLICATE.fix: Give every connection a different id.

CONN_ENDPOINT_MISSING.title: Connection points to a missing step
CONN_ENDPOINT_MISSING.summary: A connection source or target is not the id of any step.
CONN_ENDPOINT_MISSING.message: {connection} points to a step that is not there (source or target).
CONN_ENDPOINT_MISSING.fix: Set source and target to ids of steps in the file, or remove the connection.

CONN_SELF.title: Connection joins a step to itself
CONN_SELF.summary: A connection has the same step as its source and target.
CONN_SELF.fix: Remove the connection, or point it at a different step.

CONN_DUPLICATE.title: Connection appears twice
CONN_DUPLICATE.summary: Two connections join the same source to the same target.

CONN_LOOP.title: Connections form a loop
CONN_LOOP.summary: A connection closes a cycle, so the flow never ends.
CONN_LOOP.message: {connection} closes a loop in the connections.
CONN_LOOP.fix: Remove a connection so the flow runs one way.

CONN_NOT_FOUND.title: Connection does not exist
CONN_NOT_FOUND.summary: A command asked to remove a connection that no connection in the project matches.
CONN_NOT_FOUND.message: No connection joins step "{source}" to step "{target}".
CONN_NOT_FOUND.fix: Use the ids of two steps that are connected, source first.

MARK_NOT_AN_OBJECT.title: AI mark is not an object
MARK_NOT_AN_OBJECT.summary: The modifiedBy AI mark is present but is not an object with a tool name and a time.
MARK_NOT_AN_OBJECT.message: The AI mark (modifiedBy) must be an object with a tool name and a time. Removing the modifiedBy field fixes the file.
MARK_NOT_AN_OBJECT.fix: Remove the modifiedBy field, or make it an object with a tool name and an ISO time.

MARK_TOOL_INVALID.title: AI mark tool is invalid
MARK_TOOL_INVALID.summary: The AI mark has no tool name, or the tool name is not text that is not empty.
MARK_TOOL_INVALID.message: The AI mark tool name (modifiedBy.tool) must be text that is not empty. Removing the modifiedBy field fixes the file.
MARK_TOOL_INVALID.fix: Remove the modifiedBy field, or set tool to the name of the tool.

MARK_TIME_INVALID.title: AI mark time is invalid
MARK_TIME_INVALID.summary: The AI mark has no time, or the time is not an ISO date and time.
MARK_TIME_INVALID.message: The AI mark time (modifiedBy.at) must be an ISO date and time, such as 2026-11-20T09:30:00.000Z. Removing the modifiedBy field fixes the file.
MARK_TIME_INVALID.fix: Remove the modifiedBy field, or set at to an ISO date and time.

CMD_UNKNOWN.title: Command is unknown
CMD_UNKNOWN.summary: The command name is not one of the commands this server offers.
CMD_UNKNOWN.fix: Call one of the listed commands.

CMD_ARGUMENTS_INVALID.title: Command arguments are not an object
CMD_ARGUMENTS_INVALID.summary: The command arguments are present but are not an object of named values.
CMD_ARGUMENTS_INVALID.message: The arguments for {command} must be an object of named values.
CMD_ARGUMENTS_INVALID.fix: Send the arguments as an object, for example { "name": "Build" }.

CMD_ARGUMENT_UNKNOWN.title: Command argument is not accepted
CMD_ARGUMENT_UNKNOWN.summary: The command was sent an argument it does not accept, such as a position.
CMD_ARGUMENT_UNKNOWN.fix: Remove the arguments that are not accepted and send only the accepted ones.

STEP_NAME_EMPTY.title: Step name is empty
STEP_NAME_EMPTY.summary: A command was given a step name that is missing, not text, or blank.
STEP_NAME_EMPTY.message: {step}: the name (name) must be text that is not empty.
STEP_NAME_EMPTY.fix: Send a name that is text with at least one visible character.

STEP_NOT_FOUND.title: Step does not exist
STEP_NOT_FOUND.summary: A command named a step id that no step in the project has.
STEP_NOT_FOUND.message: The step with id "{id}" does not exist. Valid steps: {steps}.
STEP_NOT_FOUND.fix: Use the id of one of the valid steps.

STEP_TARGET_INVALID.title: Step id argument is invalid
STEP_TARGET_INVALID.summary: A command needs the id of a step and was given none, or an id that is not text.
STEP_TARGET_INVALID.message: This command needs the id of a step (stepId). Valid steps: {steps}.
STEP_TARGET_INVALID.fix: Send stepId as the id of one of the valid steps.
